headline: Messi plays final match for Argentina, scores and assists twice
summary: Lionel Messi contributed to all three goals in a 3-0 win over Benin in Buenos Aires, marking his emotional farewell to the national team.
details: Lionel Messi played his 208th and final match for Argentina in a 3-0 exhibition victory over Benin on Tuesday in Buenos Aires at the Estadio Monumental.
The 39-year-old superstar contributed to all three goals, providing two assists and scoring his 126th career goal for the national team via a penalty kick in the 70th minute.
In an emotional post-match address, Messi told the sold-out crowd that saying goodbye to the national team was the 'saddest day of my career' and that he will miss defending the national colors.
Messi's international career spanned nearly two decades, starting in 2005. He served as captain since 2011 and holds the record for most goals and appearances for Argentina.
During his tenure, he led Argentina to victory in the 2021 and 2024 Copa America and the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, scoring 21 goals in World Cup competitions across six tournaments.
While retiring from international football, Messi remains under contract with Inter Miami of Major League Soccer through the 2028 season.
The farewell match was attended by his family, including his mother, wife, and sons Thiago, Mateo, and Ciro, who joined him on the field for the national anthem.
Messi also paid tribute to his late father, Jorge, who passed away on August 8 after an illness.
caption:
The 'last tango' is over. Lionel Messi has played his final game for Argentina.

Lionel Messi played his 208th and final match for Argentina in a 3-0 exhibition victory over Benin on Tuesday in Buenos Aires at the Estadio Monumental.

The 39-year-old superstar contributed to all three goals, providing two assists and scoring his 126th career goal for the national team via a penalty kick in the 70th minute.

In an emotional post-match address, Messi told the sold-out crowd that saying goodbye to the national team was the 'saddest day of my career' and that he will miss defending the national colors.

Messi's international career spanned nearly two decades, starting in 2005. He served as captain since 2011 and holds the record for most goals and appearances for Argentina.

During his tenure, he led Argentina to victory in the 2021 and 2024 Copa America and the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, scoring 21 goals in World Cup competitions across six tournaments.

While retiring from international football, Messi remains under contract with Inter Miami of Major League Soccer through the 2028 season.

The farewell match was attended by his family, including his mother, wife, and sons Thiago, Mateo, and Ciro, who joined him on the field for the national anthem.

Messi also paid tribute to his late father, Jorge, who passed away on August 8 after an illness.

headline_marked: 723 tons of rice distributed as [[22-day ban on ilish catching begins]]
headline: 723 tons of rice distributed as 22-day ban on ilish catching begins
summary: Nearly 29,000 registered fishermen in Shariatpur are receiving government food aid to support them during the breeding season ban.
details: The Department of Fisheries has begun distributing 723 metric tons of rice to 28,929 registered fishermen in Shariatpur. Each eligible fisherman is receiving 25 kg of rice to support their livelihood during the fishing ban.

A 22-day ban on catching mother Hilsa (ilish) has been implemented from midnight on October 7 to midnight on October 29. The ban aims to ensure the safe breeding of the fish in the rivers of the Shariatpur district, specifically in the Padma and Meghna river basins.

The distribution is taking place across four upazilas: Jazira, Naria, Gosairhat, and Bhedarganj. This government assistance is designed to prevent fishermen from violating the ban to meet their basic needs.

Authorities have urged fishermen not to enter the rivers during the prohibition period. They warned that operations will continue to prevent the illegal catching, transportation, selling, and stockpiling of mother Hilsa.
